🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; Utilities, Communication and Healthcare leading while Technology and Financials lag — confirms money rotating, not broad risk-off. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 performers span 5 sectors). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND and SO/CEG-driven strength; Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare constructive: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth supports rotation into defensives/cyclicals.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND and GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary mixed with pockets of weakness (TSLA 1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71% BELOW TREND).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); rotation into select names, not a single-sector rally.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials and select Big Tech — narrow negative leadership on the downside.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; note major divergence: several large-cap names show 1W vs 1M mismatch (multiple RECOVERYs and multiple BELOW TREND Tech/Financials) — treat as tactical rotations, not durable broad trend change.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure with negative 1W and 1M signs; NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — sector showing internal rotation and short-term bounces but overall weakness persists. Sector breadth: negative at the moment (Technology flagged down).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are broadly weak: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND — breadth in Financials is poor and confirms rotational flow away from banks this week. Watch for stabilization before re-engaging.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows defensive bid: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — sector supplying relative safety within the rotation. Sector breadth: positive for now.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/resources and defensive healthcare: XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to big tech and weak banks showing BELOW TREND such as NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND and BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities and Healthcare (both positive this week; breadth supportive). BEARISH: Technology and Financials (both showing clear 1W weakness and multiple large-cap names BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — watch for failure to reclaim short-term consolidation as a sign of deeper trend risk. AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION — monitor hold of the 1M base for re-entry signals. JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND — a sustained move above recent 1W resistance would indicate stabilization. JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuation above recent highs.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (+80): Freeport Grasberg operating-rights headline; FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. (Limited SP100 overlap among top bullish headlines; FCX is a clear cross-check.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-65): FSD safety concerns; TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. PYPL (-55): lawsuits/CEO change; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — news is divergent vs the 1W snap, monitor for follow-through. IBM (-50): legacy/AI concerns; IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming downtrend. WFC (-45): governance/valuation scrutiny; WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND — confirming weakness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with mixed style; breadth: 7/11 sectors positive and leadership is broad (no single-sector dominance). NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence between short-term recoveries (multiple RECOVERYs) and broad Tech/Financials BELOW TREND — watch sentiment-led reversals (TSLA -65, PYPL -55).
